call.doc: The call's own rows (the call bar, the status line): the call's room, which may differ from the room on screen.

conversation.doc: A room's timeline (keyboard focus in the list, not in a text field).

dmStrip.doc: A DM bubble on the rail (an invite bubble also supplies the invite).

event.doc: A calendar event: its chat card, the calendar, the Up next widget.

hearPill.doc: A "can they hear me?" pill in the call status line.

invite.doc: An invite row (rail, room list, DM strip).

keysOnly.doc: Reached only by its key; never in a row, a menu or the palette.

member.doc: A member row in room info & members.

message.doc: A message in a timeline: its hover bar and its menu.

mutedBubble.doc: The "You're muted" bubble over the mic button.

person.doc: A person in a call: the person menu (tile ⋯, right-click, a call row in the room list).

rail.doc: The spaces rail: a space's menu, drag to reorder.

roomList.doc: A row of the room list.

sound.doc: A sound card on the soundboard.

startupCard.doc: The "Tin Hat is open in another tab" card (web).

tile.doc: A call tile: its chrome buttons and its menus.

doc: Every action of Tin Hat (desktop + web): identity, presentation, availability, target, toggle, shortcuts, confirm, contexts, the row kinds and the menus. Normative text: ACTIONS.md. Byte-identical in both repos; generated by tools/actions/gen/build_actions.py.

app.doc: The ☰ app menu (the account island's Menu). 2026-09-29: Settings, Edit layout, Theme, About, Sign out.

member.doc: A member row's menu in room info & members.

message.doc: Right-click (long-press) a message, or its hover bar's ⋯.

new.doc: The room column's + (2026-09-29): New DM, and New room only while a space is selected.

person.doc: A person in a call: tile ⋯, right-click a tile, a call row in the room list.

room.doc: Right-click (long-press) a room in the room list.

space.doc: Right-click (long-press) a space on the rail.

status.doc: The Your status popover (the account island's avatar and name).

emoji.doc: A string of 1–16 code points, no space and no control characters.

int.doc: An integer JSON number from min to max.

text.doc: A string of 1..max code points, no control characters.

placeholder.label: Needs a newer Tin Hat
placeholder.tip: This button comes from a newer Tin Hat. Update Tin Hat to use it.

app.portable.doc: Running from an unpacked zip, not an installation (Windows).

app.safeMode.doc: The app started in safe mode after a failed start.

calendar.canEdit.doc: You may edit the open calendar's games and rules.

calendar.canInvite.doc: You may invite people to the open calendar's space.

calendar.hasContainer.doc: At least one of your spaces has a calendar.

call.aside.doc: You are in a corner (pulled aside) within the call.

call.canModerate.doc: You may moderate this call (server mute, disconnect).

call.gameChat.doc: You are in the game's own voice chat (call audio ducked).

call.hangingUp.doc: Leaving the call is in progress.

call.hasSavedAudioSource.doc: An audio source to share was picked before.

call.hiddenTiles.doc: At least one stream is hidden.

call.musicPlaying.doc: You are sharing audio (an app, a device, or music).

call.needsGesture.doc: The browser needs a tap before call audio can play again (web).

call.pinned.doc: A tile is pinned as the main view.

call.recActive.doc: The room's recorder is recording this call.

call.serverMuted.doc: A moderator muted your microphone for everyone.

call.shareRecOnly.doc: Your screen share goes to the recording only.

call.soundPlaying.doc: A soundboard sound is playing in the call.

composer.editing.doc: The focused composer is editing a sent message.

composer.empty.doc: The focused composer holds no text and no staged file.

composer.hasTarget.doc: The focused composer has a reply or edit target, or staged files, to cancel.

crypto.backup.doc: Encryption keys are backed up on the server (key backup is set up).

crypto.unverified.doc: This device is not verified yet.

event.canEdit.doc: You may edit the event (its creator or a moderator).

gif.available.doc: The GIF picker is available (the GIF proxy answers).

inviteCode.live.doc: The invite code still works (not used up, expired or revoked).

invites.operator.doc: You may create registration invite codes (Synapse admin or listed operator).

memories.selected.doc: A memory is open in the Memories player.

memories.synced.doc: The Memories player is synced with the call.

message.hasEmbed.doc: The message shows an embed card.

message.interactive.doc: The message can be replied to and reacted to (sent, not redacted, not a state event).

message.media.doc: The message carries a file, image or video.

overlay.available.doc: The voice overlay can run here (desktop: KDE layer-shell; web: Document Picture-in-Picture).

person.bannedHere.doc: The person is banned from the context's room.

person.hasJoinSound.doc: The person has a join sound.

person.inCorner.doc: The person is in a corner within the call.

person.inMyCorner.doc: The person is in your corner.

person.invitedHere.doc: The person is invited to the context's room (not joined).

person.serverMuted.doc: The person's microphone is muted for everyone.

platform.screenCapture.doc: This app can capture the screen (always on the desktop; browsers that offer getDisplayMedia).

platform.web.doc: Running as Tin Hat Web (false in the desktop app). Derived from the app, never read from the snapshot (ACTIONS.md §4.2).

prefs.callBarPinned.doc: Keep call buttons visible is on (the call bar's pin, Settings → Calls; off by default): the call bar stays shown in a call instead of hiding 3 s after the pointer stops.

prefs.callUnfocusedSaver.doc: Save GPU while Tin Hat isn't focused is on (Settings → Appearance → Performance, off by default): every unfocused rule applies (GPU.md §1).

prefs.desktopNotifications.doc: Notifications for mentions and DMs are on.

prefs.reduceMotion.doc: Tin Hat's Reduce motion switch is on.

presence.busy.doc: A sharing change is still being saved.

presence.sharing.doc: You share your status with friends (Reach).

push.available.doc: This browser can receive notifications while Tin Hat is closed (web push).

push.enabled.doc: Notifications while Tin Hat is closed are on.

push.quiet.doc: Closed-app notifications only while you are away from your computer.

reel.adminOpen.doc: The reel's Tune panel is open.

reel.canReset.doc: You may reset tonight's spins (a moderator of the space).

reel.canSpin.doc: The Game Reel can spin now.

reel.canVeto.doc: You have a veto left for the standing result.

reel.editorOpen.doc: The reel's My games editor is open.

reel.isAdmin.doc: You may tune the Game Reel (space admin).

reel.respinsLeft.doc: You have a re-spin left tonight.

room.callLive.doc: A call is live in the room.

room.canBan.doc: You may ban people from the room.

room.canChangeAvatar.doc: You may change the room's photo (and its guest link).

room.canChangePower.doc: You may change people's roles in the room.

room.canChangeTopic.doc: You may change the room's topic.

room.canInvite.doc: You may invite people to the room.

room.canKick.doc: You may remove people from the room.

room.canPin.doc: You may pin messages in the room.

room.current.doc: The room is the one open in the main window.

room.guestLinkOn.doc: The room has a guest link (guests can join its call).

room.hasActivity.doc: The room shows a "now playing" game.

room.hasJoinCode.doc: The room's now-playing game has a join code.

room.inCall.doc: You are in this room's call.

room.inSpace.doc: The room belongs to a space.

room.invited.doc: You are invited to the room (not joined yet).

room.isDm.doc: The room is a direct message.

room.joined.doc: You are a member of the room.

room.myStatus.doc: You have a status line in the room.

room.recordOn.doc: Calls in the room are recorded (Memories).

session.busy.doc: A refresh or initial sync is running (Refresh rooms waits).

sound.favourite.doc: The sound is one of your favourites.

sound.inRoom.doc: The sound is one of the room's sounds.

sound.playing.doc: The sound is the one playing now.

sound.roomEntryMine.doc: You added the sound to the room's sounds.

space.canBan.doc: You may ban people from the space.

space.canKick.doc: You may remove people from the space.

space.canManage.doc: You may change the space (name, photo, topic, who can join).

space.invited.doc: You are invited to the space.

space.joined.doc: You are a member of the space.

tile.listening.doc: You listen to this share's audio.

tile.pinned.doc: The tile is pinned as the main view.

tile.recStream.doc: The tile is a recording-only stream.

tile.share.doc: The tile is a screen share.

tile.tunedIn.doc: You tuned in to this recording-only stream.

ui.callCollapsed.doc: The call tiles are collapsed to the status line.

ui.callMaximized.doc: "Fill the app" is on: the call takes the whole window.

ui.callShown.doc: The call stage is on screen (in a call with the call island visible).

ui.healthOpen.doc: The stream health popup is open.

ui.navCorner.doc: The nav is tucked into the window corner (corner mode) instead of the sidebar.

ui.phone.doc: The phone (stack) form is showing (web below 700 px).

ui.reelOpen.doc: The Game Reel window is open.

ui.rightPanelTab.doc: The tab showing in room info & members (none while it is closed).

ui.roomOpen.doc: A room page is showing in the main window.

ui.selfPip.doc: Your own camera is shrunk into a corner of the stage.

ui.soundboardOpen.doc: The soundboard is open, or a sound is playing.

ui.spaceSelected.doc: A space is selected in the rail (not Home or People).

update.hasNotes.doc: The available update has release notes.

watchParty.canControl.doc: You may drive the Media Party (host, or anyone may drive).

watchParty.in.doc: You are in this room's Media Party.

watchParty.isHost.doc: You hold the floor in the Media Party.

account.main.doc: The account island, after your avatar, name and status.

app.menu.open.tip: Menu — settings, theme, sign out…  (Ctrl+, opens Settings)

buttons.main.doc: A button island you made yourself (Stream Deck style): context-free actions only.

call.bar.doc: The call controls (the call's room is the context).

call.phoneTop.doc: Web phones: the call's top row.

call.status.doc: The call status line, right side (the call's room is the context).

call.layout.set.label: Layout
call.layout.set.tip: How the call grid is arranged

call.tile.doc: Every call tile's chrome buttons (top right).

composer.end.doc: The composer, after the text field.

composer.start.doc: The composer, before the text field.

header.main.doc: The room header, after the room's name and the next-up chip.

header.phoneEnd.doc: Web phones: the room header, after the room's name (the host folds all but the first into ⋯ More).

header.phoneStart.doc: Web phones: the room header, before the room's avatar.

nav.main.doc: The nav island: Home, Favourites, People, Rooms.

rooms.header.doc: The room column's header, after the space's name.

timeline.hover.doc: A message's hover bar in the timeline.

app.doc: Every Tin Hat window (desktop: Qt.ApplicationShortcut; web: anywhere on the page).

composer.doc: A composer's text field has focus.

conversation.doc: A room's timeline has keyboard focus (no text field).

main.doc: The main window (desktop: Qt.WindowShortcut of the main window; web: focus outside the in-page windows).

call.gameChat.doc: You are in the game's own voice chat (call audio ducked).

call.musicPlaying.doc: You are sharing audio (an app, a device, or music).

call.shareRecOnly.doc: Your screen share goes to the recording only.

call.soundName.doc: The name of the soundboard sound playing in the call.

memories.synced.doc: The Memories player is synced with the call.

message.myReactions.doc: The reactions you put on the message (emoji keys).

person.serverMuted.doc: The person's microphone is muted for everyone.

room.guestLinkOn.doc: The room has a guest link (guests can join its call).

room.pinnedCount.doc: How many messages the room has pinned ("3").

update.version.doc: The version an available update brings ("10.7.0").

watchParty.in.doc: You are in this room's Media Party.

audioSource.doc: An app or device whose sound can be shared (device-local).

choice.doc: One of the action's own values (target.values).

device.doc: An audio input, output or camera of THIS computer (device-local).
device.subject: device

invite.doc: A pending room, space or DM invite (from the context).
invite.subject: invite

inviteCode.doc: A registration invite code (from the context).
inviteCode.subject: inviteCode

participant.doc: A call participant device (@user:server:DEVICE) (from the context); named by its person.
participant.subject: participant

person.doc: A person, by Matrix user id.

railSpace.doc: A rail entry: home, favourites, people, orphans (Rooms) or a space's room id (then it is the space subject).

room.doc: A room or DM, by Matrix room id.

sound.doc: A soundboard sound, by its reference (mxc:// or https:// URL).

space.doc: A space, by Matrix room id.
space.subject: space

status.doc: A status preset, or custom with params text / emoji / colour.

theme.subject: theme

tile.doc: A call tile (from the context or the hidden-streams picker).
tile.subject: tile

deviceKey.doc: A device-local key (an audio node, a camera id, an app's audio source id); spaces allowed.

enum.doc: One of the action's own target.values.

railSpace.doc: home, favourites, people, orphans — or a space's room id.

roomId.doc: A Matrix room id: '!' then 1–254 characters, no spaces or control characters.

soundRef.doc: A sound's reference: its mxc:// or https:// URL.

themeId.doc: A theme id (the theme contract's id syntax, ENGINE.md §4: ^[a-z0-9.:-]{1,64}$).

userId.doc: A Matrix user id: '@', a localpart, ':', a server; no spaces or control characters.
